title: EMERGENCY: restore union-eyes production (ImagePullBackOff outage since 2026-09-19)
description: Production union-eyes revision nzila-os-union-eyes-prod--0000247 has been in ImagePullBackOff since 2026-09-19: the image index prod-continuity-managed-20260918-1245 references an amd64 child manifest that no longer exists in nzilacanadaacr, and every earlier prod image digest is also missing (soft-delete disabled, no recovery path). unioneyes.app, www and app return 504 or time out. This change rebuilds and deploys union-eyes to production from main through deploy-union-eyes.yml (digest-pinned) to restore service. Authorized by the platform owner on 2026-10-05. A post-implementation review is required, including root-causing the ACR manifest purge. Approval recorded for role service_owner by Aubert Nungisa (anungis437), platform owner, 2026-10-05.
impact_summary: Restores a fully unavailable production service. Deploys current main (about 16 days of drift from the last running prod build); the pipeline applies the mandatory ICRA capability migration and Django migrations. Customer-facing availability is currently zero, so deploy risk is accepted over continued outage.
rollback_plan: No prior prod image is recoverable from ACR. If the new revision is unhealthy, keep the failed revision out of traffic and re-run the deploy from a corrected commit; the app is already down so there is no healthy state to roll back to. Do not delete the new image digest.

post_implementation_review.observations: Service restored: revision nzila-os-union-eyes-prod--0000249 healthy at 100% traffic, /api/ready 200, database health ok. Follow-ups since: RLS closure applied and verified 1167/1167 (CHG-2026-0110); prod web link corrected with an immutable digest-pinned artifact (CHG-2026-0111). Remaining open and keeping this outcome at PARTIAL_SUCCESS: (1) no prior Union Eyes prod image exists, so this release has no rollback target (the current image is SHA-tagged and becomes the next release's rollback target); (2) the registry purge cause is UNKNOWN and ACR diagnostics, tag retention and rollback-image retention are not implemented; (3) customer impact (2026-09-19 to 2026-10-05) is not quantified. Full review: ops/change-records/CHG-2026-0109.pir.md.
